title: E-DI Contracts §9 compliance checklist — machine-readable (v1.27.0)
description: DERIVED from Contracts §9 by tools/build_schemas.py, with the authored `why` annotations re-attached by clause id (they are authored, not generated — a wholesale regeneration loses them). Ids are stable and never renumbered (Contracts §12); retired ids stay reserved.

rule_index.note: Published by the corpus in EDI-RULE-INDEX.json. Every NORMATIVE rule has exactly one disposition; an uncovered rule is a corpus defect, not an implementation one.

outcomes_vocabulary.note: The corpus's readings vocabulary (Instrument, 'Readings — and when scoring is allowed'), aligned here so the audit speaks the doctrine's words. The pre-2026-09-29 names (pass / fail / not_assessed) are aliases only.
outcomes_vocabulary.conforms: The clause holds, with the observation cited.
outcomes_vocabulary.does_not_conform: The clause does not hold, or holds only partially. The observation must name which part holds and which does not.
outcomes_vocabulary.not_assessed: The auditor did not inspect the code path this clause covers. NOT the same as does_not_conform: this is 'could not be judged', which per §5 forces needs_owner, never rejected.

scoring.method: clause score: 10 = conforms, 5 = does_not_conform; not_assessed clauses are omitted from dimensions and listed in unjudged_dimensions
scoring.rationale: §3 requires a mean threshold AND a per-dimension floor. For conformance both are 10: every clause must hold. A non-conformance scores above the reject floor deliberately — a divergence is remediable and opens a new job, it is not a discarded artifact.

clauses.clause: Buyer recorded with provenance on every job; Specialist recorded with provenance only when a bar is in force
clauses.why: A rubric that cannot answer 'who is buying this, and which master of the craft approved the standard?' is invalid. §4 loans the evaluator its authority from these two.

clauses.clause: ground truth named, with the channel that carries it
Evaluator written before the first generation
clauses.why: Work generated before its evaluator existed is not acceptable except as a labelled baseline measurement.

clauses.clause: pass rule (average + per-dimension floor) fixed before the run and recorded
clauses.why: An average alone permits a fatal defect to be averaged away. Thresholds must not be code defaults, and must not restate the EXAMPLE values.

clauses.clause: cap and budget set; both enforced
clauses.why: The cap is finite and recorded with the job; the implementation must state whether it counts generations or regenerations.

clauses.clause: roles separate; no self-scoring anywhere in the path
observation channel blind to the answer it is checked against; no self-report scoring
clauses.why: Two distinct blindnesses: the channel must not see the answer, AND the judge must score independent observation rather than the maker's self-report.

clauses.clause: Evaluator output validates against §5
clauses.why: Structured data, never prose alone. Exactly four verdict values — no synonyms.

clauses.clause: terminal state is one of accepted / needs_owner / rejected
clauses.why: Terminal states are exactly three. There is no fifth state in which the loop quietly ends.

clauses.clause: external writes verified by read-back
clauses.why: Declare the normalization; carry a value fresh on every run, or a skipped write passes verification whenever the target already holds the intended value.

clauses.clause: escalation classes defined, the human seat named, and the Orchestrator escalates rather than decides on values, doctrine, capability gaps, and Buyer/Specialist conflict
every iteration persisted, so a terminal decision is reconstructable

instruments retained with the artifact: §5's evaluation record (complete), plus an instrument record with the rubric (anchors and provenance), Evaluator identity, ground-truth version, and the control runs from each comparison
clauses.why: A judge without a rubric has nothing to execute; a revision without the accepted version to re-run as a control cannot detect regression.

clauses.clause: a revision is judged against a same-batch control: re-use of the retained instrument supplied and recorded, fresh bounds, the control's noise floor measured (N repeats, spread max−min), per-dimension deltas against that control, and regression distinguished from below-bar — never attributed from a pooled average, and a run without a same-batch control is uncontrolled
clauses.why: Equality against a stored number cannot distinguish 'this write landed' from 'it was already there', and instrument drift is reported as a change in the artifact.

clauses.clause: the record written on any external write carries a value fresh on every run (a run id, a timestamp), and equality is compared under a normalization declared before comparing
clauses.why: An idempotent retry is the common case. A freshness value asserts more than a byte-comparison can, so the weaker record cannot claim §7.3 unequivocally.

clauses.clause: the Orchestrator persists each iteration's artifact, verdict and state transition; only the Orchestrator applies the pass rule, cap and escalation; and it enforces the cap, the budget, the state machine and role separation — with no artifact reaching terminal `accepted` without a version-matched Evaluator record
clauses.why: §6's obligations are declared NORMATIVE by its heading and were reachable by no checklist line. An orchestrator that does not enforce them cannot be audited.

clauses.clause: instance extensions are labelled as instance-specific in every artifact they emit, do not weaken §3, §4 or §7, and are recorded with the job
ground truth is recorded with its version and its hardness grade, the grade supplied per job and never defaulted, and no dimension claims ground truth harder than its channel carries

the frame is supplied as a Principal-authored mandate with scope and exclusions; the dimension set is authorized by it, a dimension it neither authorizes nor excludes is escalated as a frame question rather than scored, and no excluded dimension is scored
where the mandate names a source of record read-only, the artifact is submitted against it and the source is not revised by the Maker

every observation channel declares a measured spread (N repeated passes of a fixed input, `max − min` per dimension), recorded with the job; no delta inside that spread is reported as improvement, regression or a reason for a verdict; and the spread is re-measured when a §10.3 trigger fires
a corpus, rubric or doctrine that judges other work is scored against its own Principal-authored mandate, and while that mandate is unratified no dimension scoring it against its purpose is `pass`

a retained instrument is re-derived rather than re-used when any §10.3 trigger fires — Buyer, Specialist's standard, ground truth, Evaluator, mandate — and the instrument change is recorded with the revision

the Maker is a supplied, recorded choice with the feedback forms it can consume named; a violation beyond its capability escalates as a capability gap rather than being iterated; and suitability is demonstrated by the next evaluation, not asserted

every violation states the shortfall with the observation and a class; a remedy is included where the Evaluator has an insight into rectification and its absence is not a defect in the record; a fabricated remedy is itself a violation

every dimension carries the observation its score rests on, produced by the channel the dimension names; an empty or missing `observation` means the dimension could not be judged — a forced `needs_owner`, never a synthesised, averaged or below-floor score

the record carries a terminal state (accepted / needs_owner / rejected) and the outcome it exited under (accepted / rejected / needs_owner / census / no_observation / no_artifact); a `no_observation` job's terminal state is `needs_owner`; a `no_artifact` job's terminal state is `needs_owner`; a readings-only job's terminal state is `accepted` with outcome `census`

a job with no Specialist named at the outset declares `mode: readings`, supplies no thresholds and may not score; its pass rule is the readings form; outcome `census` requires every readable dimension to conform and terminal `accepted`; a `does not conform` reading exits `needs_owner` with outcome `needs_owner`; and it may not produce `rejected`

the record names the instrument in force — its version, and the hash of the rubric and the code that implements it — and that instrument is retained with the artifact; the manifest names it, so it is hashed like every other retained instrument

a run in which the Maker produced no artifact records outcome `no_artifact` with terminal state `needs_owner`; the test is structural, never a character count; the record names which side failed; and a null iteration is not counted against the cap and does not displace the incumbent

an `entry: B` job is a labelled baseline (§1.5); it is legal only if `reads_before_freeze` names the reads that could reveal a defect and states they came after the rubric was frozen; C3 is not satisfied by the artifact already existing; a live artifact that fails is `rejected` plus an Owner disposition and is not deleted; a fix is a new job; procedure is Instrument Entry B and this line does not restate it

a scored job carries a frame before generation: `ground_truth` rows with source, version, and hardness; `mandate_ref` as doc plus version; a non-empty `escalation` route. Readings jobs are not subject to this line. Feedback forms, the dimension set, retained-instrument reuse, task classes, and escalation classes are not structurally enforced

a §5 record names the passes that produced it; every named pass is filed beside it with its declared shape and kind, a voided attempt is filed as `void` with its cause, and a record naming a pass that is not filed fails; a dimension observed by a single pass is labelled, not failed; and the range across an artifact's passes is not `spread`, which §10.6 owns as a channel property measured on one fixed input

the instrument's dimension list is the job's vocabulary: a record's `dimensions[].name`, a filed pass's `scores[].dimension` and a channel output's dimension key use those identifiers verbatim; a pass naming a dimension the record does not declare fails as *evidence not attributable*, and a declared dimension no filed pass observed fails as resting on zero passes — zero is not one, and rule 10's single-pass label is unchanged; the instrument-to-record link is a duty on the author, not structurally enforced

a `regenerate` verdict carries at least one violation, because an iteration that names nothing it is tasked with is not an iteration; and a dimension scored below `T_dim` carries a violation whose class is rule 4's locator and whose `dimension` names it, while a violation whose shortfall is the pass rule's mean names no dimension and is complete without one; a `regenerate` with no violation, or a below-floor dimension with no violation naming it, fails the record

the job records who holds the Architect seat, and where the Orchestrator holds it the double-hat is declared; the Architect's decisions are recorded apart from the Evaluator's scores, and no score is attributed to the Architect; the artifact carried forward is the one rule 12's test selects from the scores, never the Architect's pick; readiness for the Maker is recorded as the pinned inputs, the specified fixes and the absence of any contradiction with the bar, never as a predicted pass; each iteration's input — the artifact handed over, by hash, and the defects and solutions sent with it — is recorded with the seat that decided it, and the Orchestrator verifies that what it delivered is what was decided

the Maker and the Evaluator are dispatched only by the Orchestrator and return only to it; no message passes between them directly; no seat instructs the Evaluator on a score during a run, and a change to the instrument is recorded as a new instrument

no Maker message contains held-out material, which is only material the Maker cannot see; findings reach the Maker and the Architect with every known defect and its measurement, an expected value on a fixture the Maker can see included; every built Maker message is checked against held-out material before dispatch, with the method, the result and who ran it recorded, and where the Orchestrator authored both the dimension set and the held-out material the Evaluator or the Architect also runs the check; every seat other than the Evaluator, the author and the custodian that has seen held-out material is recorded

if the job requires approvals, each is recorded with approver, time and zone, channel, scope, words or labelled paraphrase, and whether it was direct or relayed; the form is the job's declaration (standing/kickoff grant, acting-channel yes, or allowed relay); jobs that declare no per-act approval need none beyond kickoff frame, budget and bounds; a form the job did not declare authorizes nothing
